newsitem.title: UK: Japan shipbuilding orders fall 9.6pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Japan shipbuilding orders fall 9.6pct in March.

text.p: New shipbuilding orders in Japan dropped by 9.6 percent in March to 785,000 gross tonnes compared with the same month in 1996, the Japan Ship Centre (JSC) said.
However, JSC said the March 1997 figure was 18.8 percent, or 124,000gt, higher than in February this year although the number of vessels dropped by 13 to 23 ships.

The latest figures included three oil tankers, four chemical carriers, three product tankers and six bulk carriers, JSC said. Ten vessels were ordered for export, it added. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087
